Credits

Each engine of the REPL is built from the data of others: atlases, databases of studies, ontologies, connectomes, tractograms and models. Here are, for each engine, the sources of its data and how to acknowledge them. If you report a result of an engine, cite its sources; in the REPL, .credits prints those of the engine of the session.
